SAP S/4HANA Cloud for field equipment and material logistics planning and execution

Asset intensive industries have operations that need the right equipment and material supplied at the right place and the right time. This requires efficiency and visibility throughout the logistics.

Benefits

  • Enables comprehensive logistics management

    Source materials to field deployment and returns more efficiently through the planning and execution of all logistics operations.

  • Minimize loss through total asset insight

    Reduce risk of loss and optimize equipment and material usage through complete visibility throughout the life cycle of owned and rented equipment and material, ensuring that businesses can monitor and manage assets effectively.

  • Optimize equipment redeployment

    Maximize asset utilization, improve operational flexibility, and reduce costs associated with idle equipment by using the solution to manage owned and rented equipment and material that can be redeployed to different locations.

Features

View media gallery

Provide end-to-end process management

Manage the entire logistics process, including receiving materials and equipment from suppliers, outbound logistics, tracking, receiving at remote locations, and handling returns—ensuring seamless and integrated operations across the supply chain.

Enable versatile handling of equipment and material

Manage both owned and rented equipment and material, including direct purchases of nonstock items with or without a material master. This flexibility allows for the efficient management of various types of inventory and procurement processes.

Standardize industry-specific processes

Get access to the new standard processes that were developed in collaboration with upstream oil, gas, and energy customers and tailored to industry-specific logistics operations, ensuring the solution is fit for purpose.
